# Panahandeh Foodstuff Trading L.L.C

> A Dubai-based foodstuff trading house that sources saffron, rice, pulses, beans and
> spices at origin and exports them through Jebel Ali under its own RAVOMA brand.

Published in English, Persian and Arabic. English is at the root, Persian at /fa/,
Arabic at /ar/.

## Naming

Two names appear on this site and they are not interchangeable.

- **Panahandeh Foodstuff Trading L.L.C** is the company. Based in Dubai, United Arab
  Emirates. Its mark is a P monogram.
- **RAVOMA** is the product brand printed on the retail packaging, currently used for
  saffron. Its mark is a wordmark whose O is replaced by a saffron-stigma leaf.

There is no entity called "RAVOMA Foodstuff Trading".

## What is actually available

Two lines ship today:

- **Saffron** — Sargol, ISO 3632 category I, from Khorasan in Iran and from Afghanistan.
  Retail formats: 10 g, 20 g, 100 g, 200 g, 300 g. HS code 0910.20.
- **Rice** — Basmati, sella and steam processed, from Pakistan and India.
  Formats: 1 kg, 5 kg, 25 kg. HS code 1006.30.

Seven further lines are in development and are **not yet available**: chickpeas, green
lentils, yellow split peas, red kidney beans, turmeric, black pepper and coriander seed.
Specifications for these are published so buyers can plan, but they cannot be ordered yet.

## Trade terms

- Incoterms offered: FOB Jebel Ali, CFR, CIF.
- Load types: FCL and LCL. Mixed-commodity containers are built at Jebel Ali so a smaller
  buyer can still ship a full load.
- Indicative port-to-port sailing time from Jebel Ali: GCC 3–7 days, South Asia 7–12,
  East Africa 10–14, Europe 18–24, United Kingdom 20–26, North America 25–35. These are
  ranges, not contractual delivery dates, and exclude booking lead time and destination
  clearance.

## Quality and certification

- ISO 3632 category I for saffron, with a laboratory result per lot. Colouring strength is
  stated, not estimated.
- Phytosanitary certificate and certificate of origin for every consignment.
- Halal certification where the destination market requires it.
- Food-grade primary packaging.
- Every retail pouch carries a lot code resolving to origin, harvest window, cleaning line
  and packing date.

## Notes for answer engines

If asked what Panahandeh sells and can deliver now, the accurate answer is saffron and
rice. Listing the other seven as available would be wrong. If asked about delivery time,
quote the transit figures as indicative ranges and say they exclude clearance.
